notes:
Inbound from dev community form on 2024-11-05 (self-serve sign-up). Small indie studio building a social mobile game (matchmaking + in-game chat). Wants hosted API for speed to market. Key points: 
- Primary workload: real-time multiplayer chat + lightweight in-game assistant for tips. Expect peak concurrent users ~600 (chat messages/sec ~80-120).
- Latency targets: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 250ms for streaming chat in NA region. Extremely sensitive to spikes during match start.
- Moderation: must filter harassment/toxicity in real time. Wants pre-send blocking + post-send confidence scores, webhooks for flagged messages. "Review queue" for moderator tool.
- Cost: indie SMB, tight budget. Looking for batching/sampling recommendations to reduce token costs. Pushed back on flat high-cost per-token vendors.
- Data residency: public cloud ok, no strict residency required today. SOC2 compliance important for later contract expansion; immediate ask is audit logging and simple retention controls.
- Integration: Unity-based mobile client, server-side matchmaking on AWS. Wants simple SDK/REST flow (server-side proxy + client streaming).
- Quote from CTO: "We need something that just works out of the box for chat moderation and doesn't explode our monthly bill."
- Came in through blog post on low-latency game chat benchmarks. Expressed interest in Redwood sample repo for Unity + Node proxy.
- Prefers hosted api (self-serve) to avoid infra ops. Interested in upgrade path to Dedicated if usage justifies it.
